attachments.description:
⚠️ **Warning**: this will never work in swagger!

We expect to have a multipart for each FormAttachmentItem with the name equal to the Id.

Swagger does not allow dynamic naming of multiparts, so we faked **attachments** collection.

While you can upload multiple files, the name will be **attachments** for all, so these can not be mapped to the controls.
